summary: Rapid Micro Biosystems filed an 8-K for a follow-on underwritten offering of shares and warrants. The registrant (issuer) sold 3,581,000 share units (stock + Series A & B warrants) at $1.955/unit and pre-funded warrant units at $1.945/unit, expected to close May 20, 2026. The offering is a capital raise, not a special situation, with no board recommendation or advisor named. This is a routine equity financing transaction.
